Clear the schema override of a collection.

Panel: [Manage](/docs/reference/cli/panels/manage/).

## Usage

```text
huron unset [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## Commands

| Command                                         | Description                                  |
| ----------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| [`huron unset override`](#huron-unset-override) | Clear the schema override of the collection. |

## `huron unset override`

Clear the schema override of the collection.

```text
huron unset override [OPTIONS] [IDENTIFIER]
```

### Arguments

| Argument     | Type | Description                            |
| ------------ | ---- | -------------------------------------- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | str  | The default is the current collection. |
